verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a root llms.txt (HTTP 200), and a docs-scoped llms.txt also exists. Doc pages are served as markdown (.md URLs), and Airwallex documents a developer connector that links AI coding agents like Cursor, Claude Code and Codex directly to its documentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs, and the /docs.md index returns 404.
